tegmen.definition:
n. A tegument or covering.
n. The inner layer of the coating of a seed, usually thin and
   delicate; the endopleura.
n. One of the elytra of an insect, especially of certain
   Orthoptera.
n. Same as Tectrices.

tegmenta.translation: n. 被盖；大脑脚盖；芽鳞 (tegmentum的变形)

tegmental.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a tegument or tegmentum; as, the
   tegmental layer of the epiblast; the tegmental cells of the taste buds.

tegmental syndrome.translation: [医] 中脑被盖综合征(半身不遂、眼运动障碍)

tegmentospinal tract.translation: [医] 被盖脊髓束, 网状脊髓束

tegmentum.definition:
n. A covering; -- applied especially to the bundles of
   longitudinal fibers in the upper part of the crura of the cerebrum.

teguexin.definition:
n. A large South American lizard (Tejus teguexin). It
   becomes three or four feet long, and is blackish above, marked with
   yellowish spots of various sizes. It feeds upon fruits, insects,
   reptiles, young birds, and birds' eggs. The closely allied species
   Tejus rufescens is called red teguexin.

tegula.definition:
n. A small appendage situated above the base of the wings of
   Hymenoptera and attached to the mesonotum.

tegular.definition: a. of or relating to or resembling a series of tiles

tegument.definition: n a natural protective body covering and site of the sense of touch
tegument.translation:
n. 皮, 外皮, 天然壳
[医] 体被, 皮肤

tegumentary.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a tegument or teguments;
   consisting of teguments; serving as a tegument or covering.
